summary: The daily answers check no longer reports a false fold-reader difference between members that computed their summaries hours apart. Before serving kept fold-reader answers, a member marks every seat or step that now has a claim at or after the cut as moving and counts the readers again without it, so a seat whose held usage readings were flushed late, or that came back after a restart, is left out on every member alike; and narrowing reads on past the first eight differing buckets while every key it finds is moving, so a check never reports a difference with no keys

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; only the check's answers change.

schema.detail: No schema change. The kept summary file keeps its format.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The wire format is unchanged. A member on an earlier build keeps its fold readers as computed, so it can still differ from a newer member in moving seats until both run this build.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.

manual.detail: No manual step. An open answers-disagreement fault this caused ends at the pair's next agreeing check.

recovery.detail: Reverting serves kept fold readers as computed again, which can raise the false fault after a restart onto a new build.
